# Björn Borg Q3'26: Marginalerna imponerar när tillväxten dröjer

**Feed**: inderes-se  
**Published**: 2026-10-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

In this Inderes TV interview, analyst Lukas goes through Björn Borg's Q3'26 report. Sales grew only 3%, but margins were strong: gross margin was 54.6% and operating margin was just over 17%, driven by own e-commerce, underwear mix, lower wholesale discounts and currency effects. He says CEO Henrik Bunge's planned exit in March 2027 is not a major risk, cuts his footwear estimates for 2027-28, and keeps his Buy rating, pointing to roughly 5-6% annual earnings growth, a 6-7% dividend yield and a low valuation as consumers recover.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BORG — Björn Borg | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 75%

Inderes analyst Lukas keeps Buy after Q3: strong margins, consumer recovery, ~5-6% annual EPS growth plus 6-7% dividend yield, valuation not high.

#### Reasoning

Cited analyst opinion (Inderes). Q3 profit clearly beat expectations on a high gross margin from own e-commerce and the underwear mix. He calls 2026 an in-between year as wholesale customers order more in-season. He sees consumers recovering in Sweden and the Nordics and expects growth to pick up if footwear takes off. Expected total return is about 5-6% earnings growth plus a 6-7% dividend yield, at an undemanding valuation. He sees the CEO change as only a short-term risk.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the footwear push keeps failing in wholesale (Netherlands/Belgium)
- if the new CEO after Henrik Bunge's March 2027 exit changes strategy or execution slips
- if the German consumer weakens further or currency tailwinds turn into headwinds and gross margin falls
- if wholesale growth does not return in 2027
- if the dividend is cut

> *"Så vi räknar med en vinsttillväxt på ungefär 5-6 procent per år. Vilket i kombination med en väldigt hög direktavkastning på 6-7 procent. Så tycker vi att det är ett intressant case."*
